decisions.statement: A slug is looked for among the pages of every kind a deploy puts up.
The kinds are the web app, the ios app, the three services, the container recipe and the addon.
A page of any kind but the ios app is the page the index answers for that slug.
An ios app is found among the apps the mobile commands already read.
An ios app is named by the slug its page states rather than by its filename.
The ios apps are read from the checkout this code is in.
The web apps are read from the root the caller gave.
One slug may be carried by a page of each kind.
A slug more than one kind carries is refused by naming every page that has it.
A slug a web app page and a cluster service page both carry names the web app.
That pair is the only one settled rather than refused.
A slug no kind has is refused by naming the slugs each kind has.
Ios app pages that will not read refuse the call.
Nothing here says how an app of either kind is put up.
A container recipe is a fifth kind a slug may name.
An inference service is a sixth kind a slug may name.
An ESO addon is a seventh kind a slug may name.
A cluster foundation is an eighth kind a slug may name.
A kind's own name is read as every page of that kind rather than as one page.
The page a whole kind is read at is that kind's own page type page.
A slug one workstation service carries is refused by naming that kind.

definition: the kind of thing a slug names, with the page carrying that slug
